title: CORE Flow Declaration
description: Constitutional declaration of a Flow. Existence in .intent/flows/ is the sole source of constitutional standing for a Flow.

authority.description: Flows operate at policy or code authority. Never meta or constitution.

generation_mode.description: Generation strategy for this Flow's cognitive step. Optional; omission means single_shot and preserves pre-ADR-135 behaviour exactly. Read by the cognitive delegate to select between a single generate_or_repair call and an accepted-or-capped iteration loop bounded by .intent/enforcement/config/generation_budget.yaml. Authority: ADR-135 D5 (field authorized, FlowExecutor routing) and ADR-140 (routing relocated to the Will-tier delegate; the field gains operational meaning).

cognitive_capability.description: Capability id used to select the cognitive delegate for this Flow's cognitive step (ProposalExecutor._build_cognitive_delegate). Open vocabulary: no ADR fixes a closed set, so no enum is asserted here. Authority: ADR-140 D8 (field authorized) and D9 (delegate selection).

flow_id.description: Unique dot-notation identifier. Must begin with 'flow.'. e.g. flow.fix_code

description.description: One sentence describing what this Flow does.

remediates.description: DOCUMENTARY ONLY. Canonical rule IDs (ADR-091 D2 form) this Flow is authored to close. Relocated here from the action decorator by ADR-140 D8 on the reasoning that the Flow, not the bare write action, is what remediates. This declaration confers NO routing or execution authority: the remediation gate governance.remediation.active_routing_claimed_by_action exempts flow: entries, and no runtime component reads this field. Dispatch authority remains solely with .intent/enforcement/remediation/auto_remediation.yaml. Governor ruling 2026-09-14: ADR-140 D8 authorized the declaration, not an enforcement mechanism; granting it executable authority would be retrofitted semantics and requires its own decision.

steps.description: Ordered sequence of steps. Executed top to bottom.

ref_id.description: action_id or flow_id this step resolves to.

kind.description: Whether ref_id is an AtomicAction, a nested Flow, or a cognitive step routed to the injected Will-tier delegate. Authority for 'cognitive': ADR-140 D2 (StepKind.COGNITIVE). Note that FlowRegistry._load_entry skips unknown step kinds with a warning rather than failing, so an incomplete enum here does not fail loudly at load time.

required.description: If true, failure halts the Flow. If false, failure is recorded and execution continues.

params.description: Static parameters passed to this step. Caller params override these.

consumes.description: Allowlist of caller param keys forwarded to this step. Absent means current executor default (see issue #445).

produces.description: Output keys this step writes into the enclosing Flow's context for downstream steps to consume. The counterpart of consumes: together they declare the inter-step data thread ADR-140 introduced. A downstream step declaring a key in consumes that no upstream step produces fails loudly (ADR-140 D4). Authority: ADR-140 D4/D8.
